identificationModule.briefTitle: Phase III Study of S-1 + Cisplatin vs Cisplatin in Cervical Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: Phase III Study of S-1 + Cisplatin Compared With Single-agent Cisplatin in Stage IVB, Recurrent, or Persistent Carcinoma of the Cervix

interventions.name: S-1 + Cisplatin (arm A)
interventions.description: S-1 will be administered orally, twice daily from Day 1 through Day 14 followed by a recovery period from Days 15 through Day 21. Initial dose of S-1 will be determined according to the patient's body surface area (80 to 120 mg/day). On Day 1, Cisplatin 50 mg/m2 will be administered intravenously (IV). This regimen is to be repeated every 3 weeks.

interventions.name: Cisplatin (arm B)
interventions.description: Cisplatin 50 mg/m2 will be administered intravenously (IV) on Day 1, repeated every 3 weeks.
